name: sensibility
description: Typed judgments from TypeSafe's Jev during Claude's own work: a judge skill, two opt-in gates (Risk on Bash commands, Finish on Claude's final reply), a which skill that picks the skill for your prompt, and a takeaways skill that pulls what matters for your goal out of a file.

stop_gate.title: Finish gate
stop_gate.description: Nudge Claude when its final reply stops short of the request.

bash_gate.title: Risk gate
bash_gate.description: Judge every Bash command; ask before risky ones.
